scope: CPU reference qualification; aggregate measurements only, no private audio or transcripts

reference.frontend: Float32 normalized PCM times 32768 without int16 rounding; Hamming 400/160; 80 mel bins; dither zero; snip edges; LFR 5/1 with repeated endpoint frames; Float64 additive/multiplicative CMVN then Float32
reference.policy: Default upstream offline completed-segment policy; silence p0 with Float32 speech complement and probability difference 0.6, not raw speech threshold 0.6 or log odds

checkedCases: exact Float32 posterior boundary and neighboring values
14-frame rejection, final-frame onset without a closed segment, and 15-of-20 nonconsecutive onset
multiple completed segments and default 60-second splitting
zero PCM with supplied speech probabilities preserves upstream energy-floor semantics
invalid probabilities, length mismatches, nonfinite or nonnormalized PCM fail closed
policy.simplification: Audio-buffer copying and fake silence endpoints are omitted; they do not create completed output segments. Default normalized-PCM energy/SNR tests are preserved; no new RMS gate is introduced.
